text: Waited almost 40 minutes for our order even though the place was half empty. Nobody apologised.
The paneer tikka was genuinely good, but the service was so slow we nearly left before dessert.
The manager was rude when I pointed out a billing error. They charged us for an extra dessert we never ordered.
Nice ambience and clean tables. Food took a while but the staff kept us updated.
Took forever to get seated and then forever again to get the bill. Two visits in a row now.
Tables were sticky and the washroom was not clean. Expected better at this price.
Great, another 35 minutes waiting for a simple coffee. At least the coffee was decent.
Ramesh at the counter was super helpful and remembered our usual order. Quick service too.
Portions have shrunk but prices went up. Feels expensive for what you get now.
Came back because my first order was made wrong, but they fixed it quickly and politely.
The coffee machine has been broken for two weeks and half the menu is unavailable.
Staff is polite and the place looks great, but the cold brew tasted watered down.
The bill had a service charge nobody mentioned, and the menu prices did not match what was charged.
Best croissant in Jaipur, hands down. Service was fast and friendly this time.
A staff member was arguing loudly with a customer at the next table. Very uncomfortable.
